**Nouvelles cohomologies de Weil en caractéristique positive**

*Joseph Ayoub*

44 pp, 7 sections.

**Abstract.** periods” admitting an explicit description by generators and relations. We establish comparison theorems relating this new Weil cohomology to the classical ones: Berthelot’s rigid cohomology and the ℓ-adic cohomologies, for ℓ̸ = p. We also state some conjectures on the ring AK. One of these conjectures implies the independence of ℓin cohomology.

**Outline.** Front matter; 1 Introduction; 2 Motifs algébriques et motifs rigides; 3 Calcul du complexe des périodes abstraites A; 4 Action du groupe de Galois motivique; →HocoMod; Bibliographie
